name: LineFormat
remarks: For a line, the LineFormat object contains formatting information for the line itself; for a shape with a border, this object contains formatting information for the shape's border.
example:
Set myDocument = Worksheets(1)
With myDocument.Shapes.AddLine(100, 100, 200, 300).Line
 .DashStyle = msoLineDashDotDot
 .ForeColor.RGB = RGB(50, 0, 128)
 .BeginArrowheadLength = msoArrowheadShort
 .BeginArrowheadStyle = msoArrowheadOval
 .BeginArrowheadWidth = msoArrowheadNarrow
 .EndArrowheadLength = msoArrowheadLong
 .EndArrowheadStyle = msoArrowheadTriangle
 .EndArrowheadWidth = msoArrowheadWide
End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: BackColor
properties.description: Returns or sets a ColorFormat object that represents the specified fill background color.

properties.name: BeginArrowheadLength
properties.description: Returns or sets the length of the arrowhead at the beginning of the specified line. Read/write MsoArrowheadLength.

properties.name: BeginArrowheadStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets the style of the arrowhead at the beginning of the specified line. Read/write MsoArrowheadStyle.

properties.name: BeginArrowheadWidth
properties.description: Returns or sets the width of the arrowhead at the beginning of the specified line. Read/write MsoArrowheadWidth.

properties.name: DashStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets the dash style for the specified line. Can be one of the MsoLineDashStyle contants. Read/write Long.

properties.name: EndArrowheadLength
properties.description: Returns or sets the length of the arrowhead at the end of the specified line. Read/write MsoArrowheadLength.

properties.name: EndArrowheadStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets the style of the arrowhead at the end of the specified line. Read/write MsoArrowheadStyle.

properties.name: EndArrowheadWidth
properties.description: Returns or sets the width of the arrowhead at the end of the specified line. Read/write MsoArrowheadWidth.

properties.name: ForeColor
properties.description: Returns or sets a ColorFormat object that represents the specified foreground fill or solid color.

properties.name: Pattern
properties.description: Returns or sets an MsoPatternType value that represents the fill pattern.

properties.name: Style
properties.description: Returns or sets an MsoLineStyle value that represents the style of the line.

properties.name: Transparency
properties.description: Returns or sets the degree of transparency of the specified fill as a value from 0.0 (opaque) through 1.0 (clear). Read/write Double.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: Returns or sets an MsoTriState value that determines whether the object is visible. Read/write.

properties.name: Weight
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single value that represents the weight of the line.

properties.name: InsetPen
properties.description: Returns or sets whether lines are drawn inside the specified shape's boundaries. Read/write.
